confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model (DSM) - 2m
verified_facts: EA describes the 2m Composite DSM as an object-inclusive raster containing vehicles, buildings, vegetation and terrain surface.
The 2022 product merges Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys and directs users to metadata indexes for location-specific source lineage.
semantic_limits: DSM is excluded from bare-earth parcel extrema.
The 2m DSM is correlated lineage context and not an independent validation of the 1m DTM.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Overland Flow Pathways
verified_facts: EA states the flow-path dataset is derived from a hydro-enforced 1m bare-earth DTM based on the 2022 LIDAR Composite 1m DTM.
Auxiliary datasets and manual intervention are used to reduce non-real-world obstructions before flow-network derivation.
semantic_limits: A hydro-enforced derivative must not replace the unmodified primary DTM for parcel elevation extrema.
Derived flow lines are not independent height observations.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 GML feature types
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 GML exposes contour, spot-height and land-water-boundary attributes including z/property values and water-level categories.
Feature IDs are release-specific and are regenerated when a whole tile is refreshed; geometries use EPSG:27700.
semantic_limits: A feature identifier is not stable parcel identity across releases.
GML encoding and CRS metadata do not create an independent elevation measurement.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 pre-requisites
verified_facts: OS states Terrain 50 is supplied as inert data and does not include manipulation software.
GML may require translation or GIS support depending on the user's software.
semantic_limits: Software compatibility or successful file opening is not terrain-accuracy evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Esri Shapefile specification
verified_facts: OS documents separate geometry, index, attribute and projection files for Terrain 50 contour and spot-height shapefile supply.
Per-tile metadata accompanies contour data and can include flying-date information.
semantic_limits: Shapefile components are one encoding of the same product, not independent observations.
Metadata flying-date context does not by itself prove the survey contributing to an exact target parcel.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 vector tiles
verified_facts: OS supplies Terrain 50 contour layers as a national MBTiles vector-tile set using Web Mercator EPSG:3857 for rendering.
Attributes are exposed by zoom level for contour_line, spot_height and land_water_boundary layers.
semantic_limits: Web Mercator vector tiles are rendering/delivery representations and must not replace native BNG terrain sampling.
Zoom-level attribute visibility is not measurement precision.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Downloads
verified_facts: OS publishes XML schema resources for Terrain 50 contour, grid and viewing-style metadata products.
semantic_limits: Schemas describe encoding and validation contracts; they do not supply terrain observations.

candidates.name: Land and Terrain Portfolio
verified_facts: OS routes Terrain 5 and Terrain 50 as downloadable elevation products within its Land and Terrain Portfolio.
Terrain 5 is described as a detailed 5m DTM and Terrain 50 as an open coarser terrain product.
semantic_limits: Portfolio placement is discovery context only and does not provide parcel measurements.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans guidance hub
verified_facts: HMLR's official plans hub routes users to PG40 supplements on mapping basis, application plans, boundaries, determined boundaries, title plans and related services.
semantic_limits: A guidance index is provenance/routing evidence, not exact parcel geometry.

candidates.name: Boundary agreements and determined boundaries (PG40s4) publication
verified_facts: The official PG40 supplement 4 publication was updated 1 June 2026 and distinguishes boundary agreements from determined boundaries.
It links the detailed determined-boundary guidance and plan requirements.
semantic_limits: Publication freshness does not prove that a target title has a determined boundary.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: boundaries (PG40s3) publication
verified_facts: The official boundaries publication was updated 1 June 2026 and routes to guidance covering legal, physical, general and determined boundary concepts.
semantic_limits: General boundary guidance cannot promote ordinary title-plan geometry to exact legal-boundary status.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: title plan (PG40s5) publication
verified_facts: The official title-plan publication was updated 13 July 2026 and states that the title plan must be viewed together with the register and referenced filed documents.
semantic_limits: Title-plan publication or dimensions do not establish exact legal boundaries or terrain heights.
